referenceBasis: User-provided character reference images and seated-pose sketch; these are not build inputs.

selected.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished transparent game character expression atlas, newly drawn anime-cartoon Hazel / 灰泽满.
The three recent input images have distinct roles: the black stick-figure sketch labeled with an arrow to a book is the POSE GUIDE; the two full-height colored standing character illustrations (navy uniform and white dress) are CHARACTER IDENTITY, CLOTHING, and BODY-PROPORTION REFERENCES ONLY. Do not reproduce those standing poses, crop/paste those illustrations, or include their white backdrop. Create new illustration.
MOST IMPORTANT: use the NORMAL anime head-to-body and limb proportions of the colored standing references. NO chibi, NO Q-version, NO super-deformed, NO oversized baby head, NO tiny short torso or stubby legs. Match the graceful slim arms, normal hands, long legs and head size relative to body of the colored references. Keep cute anime-cartoon linework and approachable face, with simplified clean game-friendly shading.
POSE must follow the user's stick sketch: a quiet SEATED READING posture, torso upright and slightly reclined, shown in a gentle three-quarter view. The head is above the torso and toward the upper-center/right of each sprite. Both elbows are bent naturally, both hands support an open book in FRONT OF THE CHEST, slightly toward the viewer's right. The book is clearly the rectangular object indicated in the sketch. The hips are below the book. Both slender legs extend together diagonally toward the LOWER LEFT, with a relaxed mild knee bend, and both entire shoes visible. Head turned gently toward the viewer. Think sitting comfortably in an armchair next to a rainy window, NOT standing with a book, NOT sitting cross-legged on the floor. The chair itself is NOT included because it is in a separate background. Do not draw an extra armchair, floor, platform, or shadow.
One single landscape atlas, EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight separate sprites on TRUE transparent alpha. Each cell contains the full seated figure, including head/hat, arms, hands, book, hips, long legs, socks and both shoes. Generous transparent padding; no overlap between cells. Prefer a sufficiently wide canvas so each cell accommodates diagonal legs; all eight full figures must fit. No drawn grid or labels.
Row 1 costume: silver-gray hair with a pale sage-green streak, short hair and a loose low side ponytail, dark navy bow hair clip, paired red bead ornament, soft gray eyes; navy beret-like uniform hat, fitted navy school uniform, ivory collar, dark necktie, restrained gold chain/trim, small red armband, waist ornament and small green jelly pendant, white knee socks and navy shoes. Faithful design cues from the first colored reference.
Row 2 costume: same face and silver-gray hair/pale sage streak/navy bow/red ornament/gray eyes, no hat, ivory modest ruffled white dress with a small dark collar ribbon, white socks and navy shoes; faithful design cues from the second colored reference. Keep dress coverage modest in the seated pose.
Both rows hold the same small open sage-gray book with plain pages, no text. Every sprite uses the SAME seated posture and viewpoint.
Expression columns for each row:
1. eyes open, very small closed-mouth relaxed smile;
2. eyes open, slightly open speaking mouth;
3. eyes open, moderately open speaking mouth, gentle and calm, not shouting;
4. eyes closed in a natural blink, the same small closed-mouth smile.
Registration: within each row the head center, eye line, torso, book, hands, legs, feet, silhouette, scale, camera and lighting are IDENTICAL; only mouth and eyelids vary. Match scale across the two outfits. Do not introduce alternate gestures or body tilts.
Visual finish: polished 2D cute anime-cartoon illustration, delicate crisp linework, natural reference body proportions, soft cel shading, muted cool silver-gray, pale sage, navy and ivory with tiny red accents. Cool diffuse daylight, no amber rim light or yellow glow. Fine hair edges and gentle facial features.
Constraints: exactly eight properly registered full-body seated sprites in a four-column/two-row atlas. Real transparent background and gutters; no checkerboard drawn into the pixels, no matte, no panels, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no scenery, no furniture. Do not copy the stick figure's large circular head literally; it specifies arrangement only, and the colored references specify proportions.
